key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which end of the panel the indicator sits at
key.description: The left, centre or right box of the top bar.

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Where in that end of the panel it goes

key.name: indicator-visibility
key.summary: When to show the indicator at all
key.description: Always, or only once there is something to show: snapper installed, answering, and with at least one config. Hidden this way the indicator comes back on its own as soon as that changes.

key.name: middle-click
key.summary: What a middle click on the indicator does
key.description: Taking a snapshot uses the first config shown in the menu.

key.name: date-style
key.summary: How a snapshot's age is written
key.description: Relative reads as an age, which is how a snapshot is usually thought about. Absolute gives the date and time it was taken, which is what matters when it has to be matched against something else.

key.name: show-cleanup
key.summary: Show which cleanup rule owns each snapshot
key.description: Whether a row says that a snapshot is a timeline one, one of a numbered set, or kept until somebody deletes it. This is what decides when snapper will remove it on its own.

key.name: snapshot-count
key.summary: How many snapshots each config shows
key.description: Timeline snapshots are taken every hour and a config holds dozens of them, more than a menu can show. The newest this many are listed and the rest are counted in one line underneath.

key.name: lock
key.summary: Whether the list has to be unlocked before it is shown
key.description: Being allowed to read a config's snapshots is a permanent arrangement: it is granted once and it applies to the account, not to this session. This puts a lock in front of the menu anyway, asked for by polkit, so a machine left open is not a machine whose snapshots can be read and deleted by whoever walks past it.

key.name: lock-timeout
key.description: Counted from the last time it was unlocked.

key.name: hidden-configs
key.summary: Configs left out of the menu
key.description: The names of snapper configs not to show. Everything snapper knows about is shown while this is empty.
